wsoauth-discord-login-button: Label of the login button on Special:UserLogin.
wsoauth-discord-cancelled: Shown when the user pressed Cancel on Discord's authorisation screen.
wsoauth-discord-bad-state: Shown when the login's state check fails: the return came to a different browser or app session than the one that started it (common when Discord's app opens the link), an expired or reused login, or a forged link.
wsoauth-discord-unreachable: Shown when the requests to Discord for a token and the user's identity fail: a timeout, an error reply, or a refused code.
wsoauth-discord-failed: Shown when Discord's reply has no usable user ID or username, or the callback has no code.
wsoauth-discord-bad-name: Shown when no valid, free wiki account name can be made from the Discord username.
